note: Everything domain-specific the pipeline needs. A new domain (aero, mechanical) is a new folder with this file, axes.json, seeds.json and trials.json; no code changes. Paths are relative to the repository root. Grid: limitation x subdomain (axes.json "subdomain", one subdomain per run). descriptors: further archive dimensions mapped to axes.json lists, sampled toward under-represented values. secondary_axes: sampled stratified, not indexed. tool_names / brief_max_words: enforced on every brief by lint.py (guidelines/04_generation_rules.md). asset_inventory: files that exist in the solver image (rule 9); empty here because the image has only ngspice and Python, so every input file must be generated by the draft. astra_target: the review passes a draft only when its estimated Astra pass probability per attempt is at most this (0.5 = "medium"). input_root / artifact_root / deliverable_contract: the CF-1.0 interface (kforge/docs/CANONICAL_FORMAT.md) the generator writes for and the evaluator builds against. images: the solver and grader images (kforge is mounted at /forge/kforge for evaluation and vendored into tests/ for packages). verifier_families: the kforge validator families offered to the generator and kit builder. evaluator: the build budget.
name: electrical
environment: Linux with KiCad 10.0.6, ngspice 47 and Python 3 (numpy, scipy)
tools: KiCad 10.0.6 (schematic and board), ngspice 47, Python; the grader is the kforge verifier library run on the delivered KiCad project

asset_inventory.what: starter KiCad project holding the port connectors, built from the grader spec

deliverable_contract: The solver delivers a KiCad 10.0.6 project: /app/output/design/design.kicad_sch (and design.kicad_pcb only when the task grades a board). It starts from /app/starter/design, which holds one connector part per published port (field KFORGE_PORT = port name) that must be kept with its pins. Stimulus and measurement happen only at port terminals PORT.ROLE (role GND is the return). Generic R, C and L use the standard Device symbols with Value, Tolerance (C also Voltage and Dielectric) and a footprint that carries the package; any other part is a real catalogue part named by its manufacturer part number. The task never supplies a generated device model. The grader builds its own simulation from the schematic, so every requirement must be measurable from the ports by a verifier-library check.
